scope: Enumerated documented desktop capability families, including hardware and service gaps. GP8 PDF table of contents/cited sections and the 151-page official HTML manual index checked; no target runtime launched.
source_method: Read-only git show of released baseline; graph tools unavailable in tool metadata. Existing tests/assertions and validation limits inspected. No builds or test runs in this task.

status_definitions.implemented: User-facing path + source implementation + inspected meaningful assertions support the stated narrow capability. Does not certify full vendor parity or new runtime test.
status_definitions.partial: A related foundation exists, but an explicit documented subcapability, field, workflow or fidelity requirement remains open.
status_definitions.missing: No exposed authoring/workflow/command/settings path in baseline finite interfaces; imported/rendered fields do not substitute.
status_definitions.unverified: Available evidence cannot establish the feature/interoperability/platform claim; acceptance remains open.

cmd.observed: Finite command union: basic/technique/rhythm/structure/annotation/audio/print only; omitted authoring fields are absent here.

app.observed: Single DocumentController and selected track, local zoom/profile; no desktop menu/workspace/library/preferences routes.

keys.observed: Handles arrows, digit fret drafts and Enter; other shortcuts are not implemented.

view.observed: One selected track passed to native player view; beat/note click selection, fixed notation engine and scale/profile.

engine.observed: Basic note/rest/rhythm/beat/bar/track edits and finite advanced adapter.

initial.observed: Creates stringed Staff with supplied tuning; does not create percussion/unpitched/keyboard tracks.

import.observed: Imports source through alphaTab public ScoreLoader; no dedicated format options.

gpwrite.observed: Gp7Exporter is the sole GP writer.

nativeio.observed: Native Open filter: tabplayer, gp, gpx, gp3, gp4, gp5. No alternate import UI.

nativewrite.observed: Native .tabplayer Save/Save As with source guards and atomic write path.

session.observed: Immutable source plus edit history/project session, not multi-document application state.

editor.observed: Selected string/fret editor; Set note disabled for percussion or zero tuning; single tuplet ratio/grace/text/chord controls.

tech.observed: Validated selected-note flags/enums/curves/harmonic/trill; finite supported fields.

beattech.observed: Beat fields: pick, brush, whammy, tremolo only.

links.observed: Forward tie/hammer/slur links in same staff/voice, pitch/string rules and endpoint repair.

techui.observed: Controls for supported note fields plus explicit ties/slurs and curves.

notation.observed: Single-level beat ratio, meter/pickup/free-time/repeat/endings/section/tempo, key/clef, text/manual chord only.

structure.observed: Retuning preserves string count; staff/voice creation/removal/copy and system breaks; no pitch refingering.

track.observed: Track rename/program/tuning/mix UI; new track takes name, program and string tuning.

tunings.observed: 25 built-in presets for guitar6–9 and bass4–6; Custom uses note-name entry.

transport.observed: Play/pause/stop, 7 relative speed choices, whole-measure seek/loop and metronome on/off.

player.observed: Native sample-clock transport, plans, selected-track cursor, controls and settings.

plan.observed: Prepared alphaTab musical/MIDI stream drives native plan; imported support is distinct from authoring controls.

sound.observed: 4 recorded voice overrides, GM, 5 preset IDs and fixed 8-block effects with output-device choice.

settings.observed: Only static track sounds/mixes, backing and print settings; no master, drum-element mix, automation/preset libraries.

fx.observed: Gate/compressor/4 amp models/3 cabinets/3-band EQ/chorus/delay/reverb in fixed structure.

backing.observed: Import/remove/replace/embedded backing, offset/anchors and static gain/pan/mute/solo; no waveform UI.

backingio.observed: Audio input filters accept WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG.

instrument.observed: Read-only score/track/staff/active PlanNote props; no editing callback.

liveinstrument.observed: Selected track active native-playback note sampling drives read-only instrument views.

formats.observed: Public exports: GP, MIDI, PDF, print handoff, WAV, stems only.

exportui.observed: Selection and paper/audio export options; no alternate score/image/audio format encoders.

pdf.observed: Vector systems packed into physical pages with own headers/footer; constrained layout settings.

print.observed: Writes PDF then opens external default viewer; does not invoke a native printer dialog itself.

midiexport.observed: Standard MIDI generation/export; its own channel allocation and selected occurrences.

readme.observed: Project overview and current scope; overview text alone is not behavior proof.

validation.observed: Explicit GP export losses, 15 melodic MIDI-track limit, platform/audio/printing/signing limits; old scope completion is not parity.

techtest.observed: Inspected assertions exercise supported enums, independent curves, link endpoint repair and musical duration.

notationtest.observed: Assertions check 1800/320 ticks, meter overflow rejection, endings bitmask, tempos, key/text/chord reopen.

structuretest.observed: Assertions cover voice limits/alignment, internal links, staff/capo/transposition and layout.

replaytest.observed: Assertions cover explicit slur reconstruction, relationship repair, program stream and attack/timing effects.

editortest.observed: UI dispatch/readback assertions for selected-string fields, curves, structure, meter and chord dialog.

enginetest.observed: Existing basic command assertions cover note/rest/duration/track/bar replay and capacity.

tunetest.observed: Preset inventory/order/pitches/filtering/readback assertions, not complete vendor catalog parity.

transporttest.observed: UI transport seek/loop/speed/metronome dispatch and validation assertions.

plantest.observed: Generated attacks/off events compared to independent public MIDI generator, plus repeat/tempo/channel/provenance tests.

rendertest.observed: Native assertions measure voice pitch/energy/envelopes/independent curves/controller sustain; not vendor sound comparison.

dsptest.observed: Native spectral/level assertions exercise implemented fixed effects; no missing FX family proof.

backingtest.observed: Backing decode/anchors/time-stretch tests; does not exercise absent waveform editor.

instrumenttest.observed: Assertions inspect actual string/fret/key geometry, simultaneous voices and kit element highlights.

pdftest.observed: Page dimensions, escaped text, vector systems and slur geometry assertions; no paper-print result.

miditest.observed: Independent byte decoder asserts event pitches/ticks/programs/tempos/selected boundaries/channel limits.

coverage.observed: Records before/after GP values for 21 groups; only asserts count/bytes, so NOT a passing fidelity test.

selecttest.observed: Separately asserts selected model relationships and probes GP phrase slur/automation retention limits.

filetest.observed: Atomic source/history/file preservation assertions; not autosave or crash recovery.

advanceddesktop.observed: Desktop authored/history/restart fixture; scope is supported fields, not all GP symbols.

exportdesktop.observed: Desktop file export snapshot/cancellation/current-speed workflows for existing formats.
